cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm back, so we'll clear up the important bit first: was the flat too quiet without me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. One answer each, yours first. You can keep it short: did you ever hear a key and hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I rang the landline just to hear you say hello. Right, that's both answers. You can choose what we talk about next; I'll make the tea. Just say hello once more before we move on.
